Accepted: Dayan includes inhibitory and excitatory populations, so wholly additive processing is not established as biologically plausible. Remove that phrase and citation while retaining the supported interpretability claim.

Accepted: shattering concerns lost gradient correlation and is distinct from norm explosion. Remove the analogy and citation; retain the thesis damping explanation.

Accepted: the source diagnoses parameter insensitivity and rank-one convergence for some propagation rules, not epsilon attenuation or conservation in general. Keep the empirical SplitLRP observation and leave its mechanism unidentified.

Accepted: Grad-CAM generality concerns CNN-based architectures with spatial convolutional layers; replace arbitrary architectures with CNNs without the original CAM head requirement.
